source_cutoff.cutoff_reason: Full 5 GB target reached; all 18 topic anchors have at least two source classes.

mechanisms.rule: A causal improvement claim names an intervention, observable outcome, rival explanation, and refutation condition.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require causal hypothesis, counterfactual baseline, rival explanation, and dated falsifier in every intervention packet.
mechanisms.gate: Remove the rival explanation from a packet; verification must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: When cause and effect are only coherent in retrospect, use bounded probes and select on observed emergence rather than a single imposed plan.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require Cynefin context, probe budget, kill criterion, signal window, and rollback for complex interventions.
mechanisms.gate: Declare a complex intervention without a kill criterion; context gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Protect the bottleneck: cap work in progress before adding throughput, agents, or schedules.
mechanisms.studio_change: Make WIP cap, queue-age signal, drain condition, and bottleneck owner required leverage fields.
mechanisms.gate: Raise WIP above the cap in a fixture; queue gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: An adaptive controller acts only from observed state, explicit bounds, and an UNKNOWN route; it never infers missing observation.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require controller, sampled state, sampling delay, allowed action, and UNKNOWN behavior in frames.
mechanisms.gate: Delete sampled state from a controller frame; framing verification must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Represent uncertainty as a confidence band, option value, and kill threshold instead of a binary forecast.
mechanisms.studio_change: Add confidence, uncertainty source, reversible option, and kill criterion to intervention packets.
mechanisms.gate: Replace confidence and kill criterion with an unqualified certainty claim; calibration gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: State the stock, inflows, outflows, feedback polarity, and delay before changing a system.
mechanisms.studio_change: Keep stock, flow, loop, and delay fields mandatory in Studio FRAME artifacts and intervention reviews.
mechanisms.gate: Remove an outflow or delay from a frame; structure check must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: High-impact effects stay pending until the authorized human decision is typed, scoped, and recorded.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require approval owner, scope, expiry, and ProofPacket evidence for every high-impact intervention.
mechanisms.gate: Attempt a high-impact effect without an approval record; Gate-D must stay RED.

mechanisms.rule: Convert incidents into normalized evidence, a causal hypothesis, an early signal, and a regression gate—not a narrative alone.
mechanisms.studio_change: Add incident timeline, contributing conditions, early signal, owner, and regression case to learning closeout.
mechanisms.gate: Submit an incident without an early signal or regression; closeout must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Raw evidence becomes durable learning only through source hashes, structured mechanism cards, ownership, and future retrieval.
mechanisms.studio_change: Route evidence through source-gated cards into the Studio registry and named next-gap task.
mechanisms.gate: Delete source hash or owner from a learning record; ingestion gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Agent coordination needs explicit role, input, handoff, authority boundary, and completion signal; more agents alone increases ambiguity.
mechanisms.studio_change: Add role, input, output, authority, and handoff fields to multi-agent intervention packets.
mechanisms.gate: Spawn a multi-agent packet with no handoff owner; orchestration check must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: An unattended system needs structured state, last-success/failure, bounded retry, and a diagnosable degradation path.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require health receipt, failure reason, freshness timestamp, and recovery evidence for Studio-operating controls.
mechanisms.gate: Suppress a failed receipt and report healthy; observability gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Preserve the original intent and constraints across each boundary; a transformed artifact must remain traceable to its contract.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require source contract, output contract, and trace links in phase handoffs and Excalidraw process maps.
mechanisms.gate: Remove a handoff constraint from a downstream artifact; traceability check must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Recovery capacity is real only when an alternate path is exercised and restoration is evidenced.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require fallback state, visible degradation, restore procedure, and restore evidence for resilience claims.
mechanisms.gate: Disable the primary path and omit restore proof; resilience gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Test a reversible intervention against a shadow baseline and divergence threshold before treating a projected gain as real.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require shadow baseline, intervention variant, divergence threshold, and stop rule in experimental packets.
mechanisms.gate: Run a shadow packet with no baseline; simulation gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Human roles, incentives, and override paths are part of the mechanism—not implementation detail.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require affected roles, incentives, dissent channel, and override route in synthesized interventions.
mechanisms.gate: Remove the human override route from a high-impact packet; sociotechnical gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: Diagnose recurring structure and its constraint before prescribing effort; collaboration bottlenecks are often system design problems.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require archetype candidate, predicted stock behavior, and constraint hypothesis before leverage selection.
mechanisms.gate: Select leverage with zero archetype or constraint evidence; diagnosis gate must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: A pass claim covers relevant state × boundary × failure-mode combinations and survives a planted failure.
mechanisms.studio_change: Require situation coverage, planted-red result, restore evidence, and proof hash in VERIFY.
mechanisms.gate: Plant an uncovered failure mode; verification must turn RED.

mechanisms.rule: One scheduler owns cadence; effects are idempotent, receipt-bound, and distinct from observation.
mechanisms.studio_change: Enforce Prefect sole cadence, Temporal observation-only, and receipt-bound effect/idempotency fields in operating controls.
mechanisms.gate: Start a second scheduler or emit an effect without a receipt; control-plane gate must turn RED.
